summary.plain: DASI measured the Big Bang afterglow's angular power spectrum in its first season and saw the second and third acoustic peaks that inflationary models predict.
summary.technical: DASI first season (2000, 32 fields): power spectrum 100 < l < 900; first peak at l ~ 200, second at l ~ 550, power of similar magnitude near l ~ 800; no foregrounds other than point sources.

title: DASI First Results: A Measurement of the Cosmic Microwave Background Angular Power Spectrum
why_it_matters: The abstract says the peaks "are consistent with the second and third harmonic peaks predicted by adiabatic inflationary cosmological models".
